text:
maria_sales: Heads-up — acme-finance POC starts Mon. They want BYO KMS + HSM attestation + rotation proof. Need quick checklist + pricing delta. Any infra/security blockers? cc @ashish_se @carol_security

ashish_se: Quick q — do they expect key generation inside their HSM (never exported) or remote-sign only? Also need to know interface: KMIP vs PKCS#11. Network egress + latency implications too.

maria_sales: Security note from their side: 'key material must never leave our HSM, remote-signing only, rotation every 30 days, FIPS validated HSM.' Perf ask: peak ~600 rps signing during batch windows.

carol_security: FIPS + remote-signing is OK. We'll need: attestation doc, integration runbook, and a pen-test addendum. One blocker: our BYOK proxy currently uses TLS client auth; many HSMs expect mutual TLS with cert lifecycle. @ashish_se can we do mTLS + cert rotation?

ashish_se: Yes — we can support mTLS. Need an ephemeral cert rotation endpoint and ops to validate network path to customer's HSM IP ranges. Also confirm whether they prefer PKCS#11 or KMIP as primary interface.

maria_sales: They said PKCS#11 primary, KMIP fallback. Pricing question from procurement: how to charge for HSM-backed key ops? Per-signature surcharge or capacity-based? cc @jordan_sre

jordan_sre: Recommend split pricing: (1) one-time BYOK onboarding fee (attestation + runbook + dry-run), (2) monthly reserved capacity for Dedicated/Private, (3) per-1M key-op delta for heavy signing. For 600 rps peak we should profile signing throughput — might need extra nodes. Also offer 24/7 SRE on-call premium for enterprise SLA.

maria_sales: Customer balked at large one-time fee. Can we do a smaller POC SOW covering only attestation + dry-run, then expand if pass?

carol_security: That's reasonable. For the security questionnaire we can state 'keys never leave customer HSM' only when we implement remote-signing. Need diagrams, auth flows, and sample logs proving no plaintext key transit. I'll draft Q&A.

ashish_se: For POC we can provide a test harness and staging proxy. Minimal sign example to share with them:

```
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.internal/sign \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -d '{"key_id":"acme-1","payload":"...base64..."}'
```

Proxy forwards to customer's HSM over mTLS; response is signature blob. We'll capture latency.

maria_sales: Can devs get staging proxy access this week? Customer wants dry-run Wed morning.

ops_bot: deployer: staging-proxy deployed to staging in us-west-2 at 2026-03-20T03:22Z :rocket:

ashish_se: I'll provision ephemeral certs + rotation docs and send instructions. Need HSM IP ranges and expected concurrency from customer. @maria_sales can you obtain those?

maria_sales: On it — sending contact now. Legal also asks we support 30-day rotation window and provide proof of rotations. Automation preferred but manual acceptable for POC if we produce signed logs.

jordan_sre: We have two paths: (A) manual rotation with captured audit/log proof for POC, (B) automated rotation via orchestrator (k8s job + HSM plugin) for production. For throughput we should simulate and attach perf numbers to SOW.

carol_security: Example audit log entry we'll use in runbook:

```
2026-03-20T03:45:12Z INFO key-rotate key_id=acme-1 rotated_by=orchestrator rotation_type=manual proof_ref=sha256:abcdef
```

maria_sales: One outstanding ask — customer refuses any key escrow/backups outside their HSM. Is that a hard blocker?

ashish_se: No escrow is fine. We must ensure we never log key material or store unencrypted backups. Add CI grep checks to prevent accidental leak.

carol_security: :thumbsup: I'll prepare the security answers + runbook snippets and attach to the SOW draft. Will share by EOD.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll offer a slim POC SOW for attestation + dry-run Wed 09:00 PST and price follow-up. Will update after I hear back from customer. :pray:
